lines.text: Hey MinnMax! Look around with the mouse. I'm behind you on the couch.
I'm Richard. Nice to meet you. Thanks for coming over on such short notice to film a studio tour. It's exciting times with our game streaming tomorrow on MinnHax.
Use WASD to walk around. Head upstairs and you can see my office in the second bedroom where I made this game.
I'll stay here because I have to play Hitman Freelancer, but I'll shout, so you'll be able to hear me upstairs.
